summary: CoinSwitch EARN is a centralized proof-of-stake rewards service offered by Bitcipher Labs LLP, using third-party validators for supported assets and allowing user-initiated unlocks.
what_happened: CoinSwitch launched EARN on 2023-11-21 for supported proof-of-stake assets. Current terms describe validator-based staking and CoinSwitch states user crypto is not lent or loaned to third parties.
uncertainty_notes: Reviewed sources do not establish one universal legal-title, segregation, insolvency-priority or custody model across all supported assets and validators.
notes: Promoted from duplicate-clear candidate cya_candidate_000145 after exact-head Candidate scan passed in PR #310.
